about.title: About Me
about.description:
I am a Full Stack Developer and AI & Data Science student passionate about building scalable and impactful digital products. I specialize in modern web technologies such as Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js, focusing on clean architecture and high-performance applications.

Beyond development, I am an entrepreneur and tech founder. I previously founded DZTechLab, a digital solutions initiative, and I am currently preparing the launch of InotechPlus, a web and software development company. I am also the founder of a teleconsultation platform designed for Algeria and France, developed as part of my final-year project and startup vision.

My goal is to transform innovative ideas into real-world solutions that create measurable impact.

items.description: Developed internal cybersecurity-oriented tools and platforms. Contributed to projects related to secure coding practices, web vulnerability analysis, and application security awareness.

Founded and led a web development lab delivering custom digital solutions. Responsible for system architecture, full-stack development, and team management. Delivered e-commerce platforms, SaaS products, and business tools.

Designed and developed a comprehensive employee management web application. Implemented features for employee information recording and tracking, task organization, absence monitoring, and internal process management.
Developed an analytical dashboard for tracking company revenue and performance. Created data visualization interfaces and key performance indicators (KPIs) to support decision-making processes.
Founded a digital agency specializing in web applications, business process automation, and digital transformation. Focused on SaaS solutions and cloud integrations for companies.
Built a SaaS platform for generating multi-currency invoices and quotations, managing clients, and automating financial workflows for freelancers and SMEs.

Co-founded a cross-border telemedicine startup as part of a final year engineering project. Built an MVP enabling secure video consultations between patients and doctors in France and Algeria. Implemented WebRTC, appointment scheduling, electronic medical records, and secure system architecture with a vision for international deployment.
